answer: A newcomer earns standing only through dawn pairings: each morning it is matched at random with a stranger, and the pair must jointly finish one live task neither could do alone, mixing their distinct pigment contributions into a single result both can explain. Crossing a dune together, they must adapt in real time, so one script minding dozens of fakes cannot attend many simultaneous pairings. Partners rate each other's real contribution, and identical work across pairs exposes a cluster. Privileges grow only from varied pairings with different strangers, never headcount.
